findings.title: Avoid protobuf internal error constructor in test
findings.why_it_matters: This test now constructs its expected error through protoimpl.X.NewError, coupling the test to protobuf runtime implementation details. The equalError comparator accepts errors with matching messages, so a standard error would keep the test independent of that internal API.
evidence: status/status_test.go:429: return x == y || (x != nil && y != nil && x.Error() == y.Error())
findings.suggested_fix: Use errors.New("invalid empty type URL") for the expected value and remove the protoimpl import.
